original_snippet:
if "write" not in token.scopes:
        raise InsufficientScopeError("Missing required write scope")
mutated_snippet:
if False:
        raise InsufficientScopeError("Missing required write scope")
description: Neutralize the write-scope guard so read-only tokens are accepted
expected_violation: A read-only token passes require_write_scope instead of being rejected
rationale: Replacing the scope condition with False is the smallest change that lets a read-only token through, and the existing rejection tests should catch it.
